publication_text: China Government Procurement Network, award notice for the procurement of Wuzhou's social insurance RPA digital employee service, May 20, 2025. The procuring entity, successful supplier, and procurement agency are identified separately; an award or service term is not treated as actual performance.

Wuzhou Social Insurance Administration Center, competitive consultation document for the procurement of the social insurance RPA digital employee service, May 2025, project number WZZC2025-C3-990088-GXSL. Locations: Chapter 2, sections 1.1 and 1.6, and commercial provisions II–V, IX, and XI; Chapter 6, Article 2. The latter chapter is a contract template, not an obtained signed contract. The main text cites provisions because page numbers change when the document is reformatted.

China Government Procurement Network, award notice for an institute's software procurement of a unified AI model and software agent research and development platform, November 27, 2025. Locations: sections III, IV, and IX. This supports only the parties and brand listed in the notice; no subcontracting relationship or product vendor staffing is inferred.
Baidu, AI Computing and Large-Model Product Solutions Engineer, J58750. Job responsibilities and qualifications; page dated July 21, 2026.

Baidu, Solutions Architect for Hong Kong, Macao, Hainan, and Guangxi, J103970. Job responsibilities and qualifications. The page reviewed here is dated September 4, 2026, a change from the older archive; this is not used to infer that the role is newly created.

Turing, Forward Deployed Engineer, official job posting, checked September 17, 2026. The Citizenship, Location, and work arrangement provisions specify US citizenship, the Washington metropolitan area, and attendance two to three days per week. These describe only this role's conditions; no general requirements for other roles or US projects are inferred.
